# Metadata column_list_all

```{tags} reference, query-template, metadata_primitives
```

> [Metadata](../../metadata-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Metadata queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    table_schema,
    table_name,
    column_name,
    data_type,
    ordinal_position
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('information_schema', 'pg_catalog')
ORDER BY table_schema, table_name, ordinal_position;
```
